data.title: 放学后的窗边讲义
data.camera: 桌椅纵深斜向半身中景
data.prompt: 1girl, solo, ayachi_nene, nene_school_uniform, navy blazer, gold buttons, yellow bowtie, grey plaid pleated skirt, standing, holding papers, hugging papers to chest, adjusting hair ribbon, blush, shy smile, looking at viewer, empty classroom, wooden desks foreground, open window, fluttering curtain, sunset, golden hour, diagonal window light, dust motes, three quarter view, medium shot
data.animaCaption: Hugging a stack of lecture sheets against her blazer, she reaches up to straighten the pink ribbon on one low twin tail as you step through the door. Low sunset light slices across the empty desks and catches the dust motes and paper edges.
data.promptProse: Seen diagonally down a row of empty wooden desks in a quiet after-school classroom, Ayachi Nene waits beside an open window with a sheer curtain lifting in the evening breeze. She wears her Himematsu navy blazer with gold buttons, yellow bowtie, and grey plaid skirt, pressing a neat stack of lecture sheets to her chest with one arm while her free fingers self-consciously adjust the pink ribbon on one silver-white low twin tail. Low golden-hour sunlight cuts across the room from the right, gilding her hair edge and scattering bright motes above the desk tops while leaving the chalkboard behind her in cool blue shadow.
data.story: 夕阳把空教室染成柔和的橘金色。宁宁抱着替你整理好的讲义站在窗边，听见门响先慌张地装作理发带，等看清是你才把讲义递出来，紫眸里藏不住松了口气的亮光——「总算等到了……要是还不急着回去，陪我去趟社办好吗？」
